verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents the core loop. Datasets hold reusable test cases. Experiments can be run via the SDK (`run_experiment`) or from CI/CD. A CLI is documented for working with Langfuse from a coding agent, and score metrics can be read back via the Metrics API and the query SDKs. However, no evidence explicitly shows a dataset being created programmatically by an agent, and reading experiment-run results back is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit API/SDK/CLI docs for creating datasets and items, documented retrieval of per-run experiment results by an agent, an end-to-end agent-driven example, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create a dataset, trigger an eval run programmatically, and read back the results
